description_en: Queries the list of backup data migration tasks for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS SQL Server实例备份数据上云任务列表
name: DescribeMigrateTasks

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须大于开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30~100。默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any integer greater than 0 that does not exceed the maximum value of Integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

MigrateTask.description_en: The list of backup data migration tasks
MigrateTask.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务信息列表

items.description_en: The details of a backup data migration task
items.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务信息详情

BackupMode.description_en:
The type of the backup data migration task. Valid values:
FULL: performs a restoration by using a full backup file.
UPDF: restores incremental data by using an incremental or log file
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份数据上云任务类型，取值：
FULL：表示通过全量备份文件去执行还原操作。
UPDF：表示通过增量文件或者日志文件去还原增量部分的数据

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the backup data migration task was created. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
CreateTime.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务创建时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Description.description_en: The description of the backup data migration task
Description.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务的描述信息

EndTime.description_en: The time when the backup data migration task ended. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
EndTime.description_zh: 备份数据上云任务结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

IsDBReplaced.description_en: Indicates whether the import is an overwrite import

MigrateTaskId.description_en: The ID of the backup data migration task

Status.description_en:
The status of the backup data migration task. Valid values:
NoStart: not started
Running: running
Success: succeeded
Failed: failed
Waiting: waiting for an incremental backup file to be imported
Status.description_zh:
备份数据上云任务的状态，取值：
NoStart：未开始
Running：运行中
Success：成功
Failed：失败
Waiting：等待（等待增量备份文件导入）

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the specified conditions
TotalRecordCount.description_zh: 满足条件的总的记录数
